target.statement: ProFit (Qwen3-0.6B-Base) achieves 31.49% average accuracy across GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME'24, and IFEval, vs 28.51% for standard SFT
target.dataset: BAAI-InfinityInstruct subset (2000 samples) for training; GPQA-Diamond, GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME'24, IFEval for evaluation

compute.basis: Training a 0.6B LLM on 2000 samples with 8192-token sequences plus evaluating on 5 benchmarks with 8-32 samples each requires GPU acceleration; on CPU it would take many hours to days, and the paper uses 8 H20 GPUs.

blockers: Requires GPU for reasonable runtime (paper uses 8 H20 GPUs)
Evaluation pipeline uses lmdeploy/vllm which need GPU
Full training data curation (reward-based selection from InfinityInstruct) is not fully specified
title: ProFit: Leveraging High-Value Signals in SFT via Probability-Guided Token Selection
